name: RFP answering engine
summary: Answers questions about an RFP and its amendments with the exact clauses it rests on, or refuses.
install: claude mcp add rfp-intelligence -e MODEL_PROVIDER=mock -- python3 /PATH/TO/mcp/server.py
trust_rules: No answer without a source: a cited clause that does not exist is an error
Every $, date and % in an answer must appear word for word in a cited clause, or the summary is withheld
Citing a base clause pulls in the amendment that replaced it
Not addressed in the RFP is a valid answer; a missing appendix is reported
Drafting proposal language and bid verdicts are refused before any model call
No model available means status unavailable with the relevant clauses and no answer

example.question: What is the bid deposit?
example.answer: Section 7.1 (Bid Deposit) is revised: the bid deposit is increased from $20,000 to $35,000.
example.gate: fast path: verbatim governing text, no model call

model_dependent_cases.note: No API key where this was packaged; without one they return unavailable, as designed.

not_proven: No calibrated confidence score; results are categorical
Figures are checked; meaning is not
Plain text in one numbering style; PDFs need an ingest step
Built for RFPs; contract clause types get no special handling
data: data/ holds a short fictional RFP and one amendment written for this sample

agent_files.AGENTS.md: shared base; read by Codex and Hermes
agent_files.agents/openai.md: OpenAI Agents SDK (stdio MCP) and Responses API notes

agent_files_tested.claude_code: MCP server and eval run locally
